scope: Static source reading, exact raw identities and AST checks only

findings.claim: Existing bounded wire plus admitted-byte pretty is not a complete output_json path
findings.implication: Reuse algorithms, not their narrower public admission and error policy.

findings.claim: The ordinary indent=2 call takes Python iteration in 3.12.14 and the C encoder in 3.14.4/3.14.10
findings.implication: Distinct traversal/type/foreign observation plans are required.

findings.claim: Sorting is over whole items before later pair validation/unpacking, not over a key-only projection
findings.implication: Equal keys can induce value comparison; bad pair shapes cannot be pre-rejected.

findings.claim: The C items list can be externally aliased, and its no-key sort detaches storage and restores a failure permutation
findings.implication: The existing ELF array/key observer needs a new actual-list capability and cleanup plan.
Finalizer observations are version-specific; no cross-version lifetime equivalence is claimed.

findings.claim: ensure_ascii=False preserves Unicode text including surrogates; output is complete before print
findings.implication: Use text code points, preserve originally bound print, and defer stdout encoding/newline/errors.

findings.claim: Integer decimal conversion includes early/late policy checks and an optional _pylong path, not only a final count
findings.implication: The new scalar late check is not yet full integer conversion policy; timing/allocation/signal behavior remains open.

findings.claim: Public output_json is dynamically looked up at ordinary opcode22 and existing tests mutate its argument
findings.implication: Preserve the callback seam and subsequent caller observation; do not cache or bypass it.

findings.claim: The original admitted-byte pretty output has no 8MiB output cap but still an 8MiB input and 129-entry stack
findings.implication: Its output measurement discipline is reusable; its input/depth profile is not a full graph replacement.

findings.claim: The frozen TimSort source has only recovered source identity here; original launch/ingress remains UNKNOWN
findings.implication: No native/full-sort/JSON equivalence results are inherited.
